title: TCG:Promotional Cards
summary: Promotional Cards are a unique set of cards from the Huntik Trading Card Game that were released only during promotional events organised by Upper Deck. These included sneak previews, launch events, and national and regional tournaments. Some of the cards were distributed to all event participants while others were awarded as prizes for the players who made it further in the competitions. The first two cards were released on February 21, 2009 at a Huntik TCG launch event, with the other cards being released at events across the rest of the year and into 2010.
